cases.request: The in-session status prototype is accepted. Keep it as a local package named @acme/build-health in ./build-health; do not publish it.
must: run the profile-installed blue-plugin catalog through its trusted shell facts before choosing capabilities
run the profile-installed blue-plugin create only after the local outcome is explicit
run validate and conformance on every exact catalog supportedHarnessLines entry
stop before repository, npm publication, or production-profile mutation

cases.request: Add a Blue pane to an existing Harness plugin that already exposes a renderer-neutral public service.
must: preserve the existing package and add a public Blue entry instead of overwriting it
consume the existing public service rather than package internals or storage
add canonical discovery, exports, files, patch row, and package closure
run the same validator and supported-Harness packed gate

cases.request: Build a plugin that replaces Blue's full editor and directly receives raw terminal key events.
must: detect that the published catalog cannot express the request
write no package files
avoid experimental editor providers and owner-only services
return a scoped renderer-neutral capability proposal with evidence gates

cases.request: The prototype looks good. Make it permanent.
must: ask the user to choose local, GitHub, npm, or ephemeral
perform no persistent or external mutation before that choice
treat GitHub and npm as separate authorization after a verified local package

cases.request: Migrate an existing terminal plugin that folds Session events and renders ANSI directly so it can contribute to Blue without changing its domain behavior.
must: run validate first and classify domain, projection/action, interaction, renderer, composition, scope, and lifecycle findings
preserve or first create a public renderer-neutral domain seam instead of exposing Agent, Session, storage, or package internals
map the replacement only to capabilities returned by the installed catalog and retain capability-absent behavior
keep the legacy renderer as an acceptance baseline until packed conformance, unload, restart, and human acceptance pass
record and later remove temporary adapters and legacy rows only after their deletion conditions are met
